RAT_EV_04.statement: impact_manager y organization_admin pueden crear borradores de templates de Evaluate; solo organization_admin puede publicar o retirar.

binding_semantics.closed_sets: Each of the three role sets above is EXACT and CLOSED. Membership is by exact role identity, never by rank, threshold, or '+' hierarchy notation.
binding_semantics.draft_set_exclusions: super_admin, analyst, reviewer, and viewer are NOT admitted to the draft set merely by hierarchy or 'higher role' semantics. None of the four is named in canDraftEvaluationTemplate.
binding_semantics.publish_retire_set_exclusions: super_admin, impact_manager, analyst, reviewer, and viewer are NOT admitted to the publish or retire sets. impact_manager's draft authority does not extend to publish or retire.
binding_semantics.no_hierarchy_widening: hasRole('>='), numeric role-rank dominance (e.g. permissions.ts ROLE_HIERARCHY values), and '+' hierarchy notation may never be used to admit a role into any of the three sets above beyond what is named exactly.
binding_semantics.draft_does_not_confer_publish_or_retire: impact_manager being in canDraftEvaluationTemplate confers no publish or retire authority; publish and retire remain organization_admin-only.
binding_semantics.draft_predicate_stays_separate: organization_admin being admitted to canDraftEvaluationTemplate does not collapse canDraftEvaluationTemplate, canPublishEvaluateTemplateVersion, and canRetireEvaluateTemplate into a single predicate; a future implementation must express and test all three as distinct checks even though organization_admin satisfies all three.

MEASURED_MOTIVATION.classification: REPOSITORY_MEASUREMENT, not owner rationale. This section records why the owner question arose; the owner's decision (RAT_EV_04 above) is the binding source regardless of this measurement's continued truth.
MEASURED_MOTIVATION.measurement: The self-service organization-founding flow creates exactly one membership row for the founding user, with role hard-coded to ROLES.ORGANIZATION_ADMIN ('organization_admin'). No other role is assigned to a newly bootstrapped organization's first member by this path.
MEASURED_MOTIVATION.evidence: app/(authenticated)/app/onboarding/actions.ts:132-138 — `db.insert(organizationMembers).values({ organizationId: org.id, userId: authUser.id, role: ROLES.ORGANIZATION_ADMIN, status: 'active', joinedAt: new Date() })`, confirmed against lib/auth/roles.ts:14-19 where ROLES.ORGANIZATION_ADMIN === 'organization_admin' and ROLES.IMPACT_MANAGER === 'impact_manager' are distinct, non-overlapping role identifiers.
MEASURED_MOTIVATION.consequence_if_draft_set_had_remained_im: A newly founded organization whose only member is its founding organization_admin would have had no member able to create an Evaluate template draft until a second person was invited and/or promoted to impact_manager — the first Evaluate template would have been unreachable for that organization.
MEASURED_MOTIVATION.boundary: This measurement motivated the owner question; it is not itself elevated to an independent normative rule, and its continued accuracy should be re-measured by any implementing lane against its own base rather than inherited from this timestamped observation.
